facts.fact: APDPVP's press release acts under article 201 of law no. 025/2023 of 12 July 2023, which amends law no. 001/2011 on personal data protection, and refers to the regulations in force.
facts.system: Law no. 001/2011 as amended by law no. 025/2023

facts.fact: APDPVP states that its members and sworn agents are empowered to enter business premises, and that its plenary of permanent commissioners will decide on the measures after the inspections.

APDPVP states it carried out on-site inspections on 8 and 9 May 2025 at Airtel Gabon, Airtel Money, Royal Air Maroc and Air France, with a report to follow for a decision on possible sanctions; no decision is stated.
